statement: On the OASIS-3 dataset of 696 subjects represented as 170-node networks, the four Table 3 mean matching accuracies are diffusion CDOT 0.6136, diffusion FGW 0.1853, geodesic CDOT 0.4640, and geodesic FGW 0.5375.
route: falsification of the exact cohort invariant
quantifier: the reported 696-subject cohort is represented by 170-node Scale-2 networks
acceptance_obligations: download and SHA-256 pin the primary archive named by the data provider
enumerate every archive member, session, and subject
parse the atlas ID of every node in every GraphML
show that a subject included among the 696 has no 170-node session
reject padding or relabeling as a destructive control
logical_rule: The full empirical claim is a conjunction. A primary-data counterexample to its explicit 696-by-170 cohort premise falsifies the claim without requiring an inference about the four numerical cells.
non_circularity: The archive, all-member enumeration, exact ID set, and 170-node threshold come from the source claim and provider page, not from observed outcomes.
